pricing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
pricing.faq.subtitle: Real questions people send us, answered honestly.
pricing.faq.gpl.q: What is GPLv3 and how does it affect me?
pricing.faq.gpl.a: TypeWhisper is open source under the GPLv3. In practice: you can use the app freely for personal use. If you distribute software that embeds TypeWhisper, GPLv3's copyleft rules apply - your distribution has to be GPL-compatible. If that's a problem (most proprietary use cases), grab a commercial license.
pricing.faq.freelancer.q: I'm a freelancer - do I need a commercial license?
pricing.faq.freelancer.a: If you use TypeWhisper to produce work you bill a client for, yes - that's commercial use. The Individual tier is designed for single-seat freelancers.
pricing.faq.workPay.q: I use it at work but pay for it myself - what tier?
pricing.faq.workPay.a: Still commercial use. The license is tied to how the software is used, not who pays. The Individual tier fits one person using it at work.
pricing.faq.upgrade.q: Can I upgrade from Individual to Team later?
pricing.faq.upgrade.a: Yes. Write to licensing@typewhisper.com and we'll prorate the difference against your existing subscription or lifetime purchase.
pricing.faq.supporterVsCommercial.q: What's the difference between a Supporter tier and a Commercial license?
pricing.faq.supporterVsCommercial.a: Supporter tiers are a thank-you for individuals who want to fund the project. They do NOT grant any commercial or proprietary use rights. If you need to use TypeWhisper at work or in a closed-source product, you need a Commercial license.
pricing.faq.lifetimeUpdates.a: Yes. Lifetime covers all future TypeWhisper updates in the same product line.
pricing.faq.cancel.q: What happens if I cancel my monthly subscription?
pricing.faq.cancel.a: You keep access until the end of your paid period. After that, your commercial license expires - the app keeps working for personal use, but you would need to re-subscribe (or switch to Lifetime) to continue commercial use.
pricing.faq.refund.a: Yes. Write to licensing@typewhisper.com within 14 days of purchase and we'll refund you, no questions asked.
pricing.faq.discounts.q: Do you offer educational or non-profit discounts?
pricing.faq.discounts.a: Non-profits and students, get in touch at licensing@typewhisper.com. We usually have headroom for fair discounts.
pricing.faq.activate.q: How do I activate my license?
pricing.faq.activate.a: Open TypeWhisper, go to Settings > License > 'Already have a key?', paste the key you received after checkout, and it activates on the current device.
